name: DPP Supplier
description: Publishes UNTP Digital Product Passports for its component batches and invoices the manufacturer.
summary: Supplier wallet for workflows/dpp-workflow.md on the NOOP trust framework. It issues the UNTP DigitalProductPassport for its component batches (component_batch_passport, jwt_vc_vcdm, signed with its did:web, numeric status list index) and publishes it as a "dpp" link, and issues WEBUILD eInvoices (eu.we-build:einvoice:1, sd_jwt_vc) to the manufacturer over WMP. It holds its Digital Conformity Credentials, which needs no configuration. Created with issuers, so it gets the did:web it publishes under.
